adapter-connections.title: Developer tool connections
adapter-connections.intro: Find a tool or protocol, then open its setup or guide.
adapter-connections.direction_hint.suma_: Runner profiles, fixed execution protocols and controlled tasks
adapter-connections.direction_hint.tool_: Project MCP configuration and client setup guides
adapter-connections.boundary: This catalog describes implemented capabilities. It does not prove installation, connection, availability or permission on the current device.
adapter-connections.no_matches_hint: Try another product name or connection direction.
adapter-connections.limit.cloud_fixed_de: Requires a current WorkBuddy account grant, owner permission, a fixed node delegation and an authorized private or pool worker.
adapter-connections.limit.cloud_start_on: Only protected task start is integrated here. Session history, ACP interaction, code import, model selection and remote stop evidence are not provided by this entrypoint.
adapter-connections.limit.cloud_delivery: Starting a cloud task does not verify code delivery, independent tests or acceptance. Provider completion alone does not complete the workflow node.
adapter-connections.limit.cloud_budget_n: Cloud hard budget enforcement is unavailable. Enforced organization or project budgets block task start.
adapter-connections.planned_hint: This execution connection is planned. It cannot currently receive tasks from Suma.
adapter-connections.capabilities_hint: These are protocol declarations. Actual use also requires current authorization and matching device evidence.
adapter-connections.invalid_response: The connection catalog does not match the current project or supported format. Refresh before continuing.
adapter-connections.limit.implementation: An implementation entry is not an active connection or a verified device.
adapter-connections.limit.profile_and_cu: Requires a fixed profile, matching device and current project authorization.
adapter-connections.limit.independent_qu: Execution does not replace independent tests or human acceptance.
adapter-connections.limit.provider_usage: Reported usage may be incomplete; missing values are not zero.
adapter-connections.limit.host_stop_requ: Cancellation acknowledgement alone does not prove that the process stopped.
adapter-connections.limit.fixed_dsh_mult: Only the fixed DSH Multica profile is covered, not every Harness product or plugin.
adapter-connections.limit.fixed_claude_c: The reviewed native Claude Code 2.1.314 profile fixes model, permissions and foreground execution; other versions require review.
adapter-connections.limit.claude_cli_not: This is Suma’s foreground CLI adapter. Claude SDK execution and Claude-to-Suma MCP configuration are separate entrypoints.
adapter-connections.limit.claude_permiss: The local administrator reviews file tools and scoped Git permissions. Managed policies take precedence; file restrictions are not a Bash operating-system sandbox.
adapter-connections.limit.foreground_onl: Only the supported foreground execution is covered; interruption does not authorize a restart or resume.
adapter-connections.limit.observe_only_b: Budget is observed, not enforced as an absolute provider billing limit.
adapter-connections.limit.manual_client_: Verify configuration and project access in the actual installed client.
adapter-connections.limit.no_execution_a: Suma has not implemented this execution entrypoint. Tasks cannot be started through this catalog entry.
adapter-connections.limit.manual_runtime: The Harness name does not identify a specific runtime protocol. Verify the actual runtime and version, then choose an implemented dedicated entrypoint.
adapter-connections.limit.workbuddy_not_: WorkBuddy cloud tasks and CodeBuddy CLI are separate products and connections.
adapter-connections.limit.configuration_: Exports configuration without credentials; it does not install or connect the client.
adapter-connections.limit.profile_specif: Available features depend on the exact protocol and fixed execution profile.
adapter-connections.limit.unsupported_is: Not supported means this Suma entrypoint has not implemented it; it does not describe all vendor capabilities.
adapter-connections.limit.candidate_requ: Candidate capture requires a fixed isolated workspace, artifact transfer and a successful clean new commit.
adapter-connections.limit.host_stop_plat: Proof of stopping depends on the operating system and actual process evidence. Detached Unix child processes are not currently proven stopped.
adapter-connections.selected_execution: Selected execution protocol: {{adapter}} / {{protocol}}. Only matching observed inventory can be registered.
adapter-connections.no_matching_inventor: No matching observed configuration. Choose another device or supply inventory for this protocol, or cancel to choose another connection.
adapter-connections.limit.fixed_acp_cli_: Administrator-fixed local ACP CLI, exact reviewed version and model; configuration acknowledgement does not verify provider identity or health.
adapter-connections.limit.acp_human_once: Each tool request requires an explicit once-only decision from a currently authorized person; persistent permission is unavailable.
adapter-connections.limit.trusted_cli_no: The platform isolates the worktree and refuses client file and terminal callbacks. Native CLI capabilities depend on local trust and configuration; this is not an OS sandbox.
